title: Excellent for moving & storage & floods!
text: Excellent for moving & storage & floods!. I purchased these for multiple reasons. The main reason was that I was moving. I was moving bc my apt kept flooding.  Luckily having been through other floods I generally store all my stuff in plastic containers anyways. Sadly a couple of my vintage Singer’s in wooden boxes had been left out during the last move & the last flood got them moldy & ruined them.  I am a bibliophile & these bags held not only huge stacks of my hardcover books, but my 40 pound Singer sewing machines. I also carried hundreds of pounds of yarn (50 per bag) and thousands of pounds of quilting fabric during my move.  It held up to paints, plants, garden pits, & pretty much anything I threw at it. I even put my pots & pans in these bags.  While I still thought they were a bit pricey I did buy some on sale & I think I bought 18 total that I was able to pack & take to my new place & unload & go pack again. Tho I now intend to leave some of my yarn in them as it’s waterproof.  Tho I intend to place it on a top shelf just to be on the safe side. Lol. Not one bag ripped, tore, or had an issue so far that I am aware of tho I have not checked them over very well. And I had no issues with the zippers tho I am positive that I packed several bags well over the weight limit on accident bc I was trying to keep certain quilting fabrics together for a quilt project.  I’ve bought some real duds on Amazon, but this was not one of them. This has by far been one of my better purchases & I’ve told my kids that are planning to move to buy the bags too bc it is just so much easier imo.  I literally used a taxi to move half my stuff (disabled & don’t drive) & was able to fold the bags back down to how they arrived after unpacking to take them back to be packed again.  I also made little tags and used color coded handkerchiefs I hung on the handles so I knew which room the bags went in or knew what was in them without having to open them in the wrong room once I moved.  It saved time.  I live in an apt & these bags take up a lot less space than the massive sterling & Rubbermaid hard sided plastic totes I normally use for moving & craft storage.  I still have them & use them, but storing them is a challenge.  Also, the bags fit under my zinus/spa sensations type elevated platform bed. It’s a frame amazon sells & you buy your own mattress. Normally I can fit 8 hard sided tubs under my bed (queen bed), but I’m limited by the height of the tubs. The bags fit or I’m able to squish to fit if I overfill them which is nice.  Depending on how full you pack them you can get 4-8. They are different sizes than my plastic tubs tho.  I only wish I had stumbled across these bags years ago given how many times I’ve moved. Lol.

product_metadata.title: 6-Pack Clothes Storage Organizer, Large Capacity Blanket Storage Bags with Reinforced Handles & Sturdy Zippers, Foldable Clothing Storage Organizer Container for Comforters, Blankets, Bedding (Grey)
features: 👍Large Capacity: Each storage bag measures 21.7 x 14.0 x 12.2 in / 55 x 36 x 31 cm, with capacity 60L. It is spacious for your bed sheets, comforters, blankets, pillows, toys, jackets or other clothes.
👍Upgraded Material: The storage organizer is made of high-quality, odorless, three-ply composite non-woven fabric which promotes ventilation and protects your stored things.

👍Reinforced Handle: The handle is sewn with two layers of thick fabric, and the load-bearing capacity is doubled. Reinforced seams are also implemented for added strength. See-through window in the front for quick viewing what are stored inside the container.

👍Sturdy Zipper: Equipped with #5 stainless steel zippers which are hard to be broken, and can be used for a longer period of time. And two-way zippers allow it to easily slide along the closure when in use, no matter how full the bag is.

👍Multifunctional & Foldable: The storage bag set can be used for closet or cloakroom, also a good choice for university dormitory, attic, bedroom use. The soft and strong material allows it to be folded when not in use.
